config_profile.qemu_virt: QEMU -machine virt -cpu cortex-a57 -serial stdio; DT generated by QEMU; oneli DT never supplied to QEMU
config_profile.native_dt: qcom/sm8475-motorola-oneli.dtb is built and checked separately, not passed to virt guest

portable_bundle.sha256_fields: all payload bytes individually SHA256 and archive sha256 via GitHub Action artifact digest

userspace_v3_contract.initramfs_path: deferred: Userspace creates fresh initramfs; never fabricated
userspace_v3_contract.same_build: build_id + exact source kernel_commit/release + Image/config/Module.symvers SHA256
userspace_v3_contract.modules_sha256: complete relative-to-modules/<release> .ko inventory; no symbolic build/source links
userspace_v3_contract.firmware_manifest: v2 target_environment=qemu_virt, assessment=complete, required_files=[], unknown_requirements=[], reason specified
userspace_v3_contract.initramfs_modules: [] only with reason explaining all required virt boot/storage/network/console features are built-in
userspace_v3_contract.rootfs: Userspace independently supplies previously tested Debian ARM64 rootfs tarball and its SHA; Boot does not invent it
userspace_v3_contract.completion: QEMU virt actual uname -r, modprobe dummy, proc/modules, SSH over host-forwarded IPv4, systemd, clean shutdown
expected_fixes_in_userspace: accept one ARM64 Image independent of filename
preinstall mount cleanup before first mount
exercise preflight and mismatched-release module rejection
